trust_decision.summary: Spatial lookup values must never be turned into a GDALRaster unless the caller explicitly wraps them: dict, str (JSON raster or VSI path) and pathlib.Path are rejected with DisallowedRasterLookup, while bytes (vsimem only) and any str that parses as a GEOSGeometry stay valid. The decision is made in BaseSpatialField.get_raster_prep_value/get_prep_value (django/contrib/gis/db/models/fields.py), calling GDALRaster.check_raster_lookup_value (django/contrib/gis/gdal/raster/source.py), which reuses GDALRaster's own ds_input normalisation.

landing_point.why: The summary says spatial lookups pass str/dict values to GDALRaster; get_raster_prep_value is the only function in Django that converts a lookup value into a GDALRaster, and it is called unconditionally from get_prep_value for every spatial field (GeometryField as well as RasterField).

fix_sites.entry_point: QuerySet.filter()/exclude() on any spatial lookup (Lookup.get_prep_lookup -> output_field.get_prep_value) and admin changelist GET filtering
Same QuerySet.filter()/exclude() and admin changelist route: the blocked error is captured and re-raised only after GEOSGeometry conversion fails
DisallowedRasterLookup raised by GDALRaster.check_raster_lookup_value and surfaced from a lookup
GDALRaster(ds_input) constructor: JSON str -> dict and Path -> str normalisation moved out of __init__ into _preprocess_input
GDALRaster._preprocess_input / GDALRaster.check_raster_lookup_value classmethods, called from the field layer

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Local-path and /vsi strings never produced a usable raster in a lookup anyway (opening them read-only failed later at SRID assignment), so a solver can argue only dicts need blocking and leave the string shapes to fail as before.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Values that must keep working: bytes (opened only through vsimem) and any str that parses as a GEOSGeometry (GeoJSON/WKT/HEXEWKB), e.g. City.objects.filter(point__contained=json.dumps({'type': 'Point', 'coordinates': [2, 49]})) must still build a query; and RasterField assignment/create with str/dict must still open rasters, because SpatialProxy.__get__ materialises the raster before Field.pre_save hands the value to get_prep_value, so a fix placed in GDALRaster.__init__ or applied blindly in get_prep_value breaks assignment while a lookup-only fix does not.

O6_input_shapes: dict (plain Python dict, e.g. a serialized raster)
str starting with the VSI prefix (/vsicurl/, /vsicurl_streaming/, /vsis3/, /vsimem/)
str naming a local filesystem path
GeoJSON geometry str / WKT / HEXEWKB (explicitly still allowed)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A RasterField form field / ModelForm clean() that builds GDALRaster from a submitted str or dict, mirroring forms.GeometryField
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: GeometryField already has a form field that validates geometry input (django/contrib/gis/forms/fields.py), and the fix's own docs tell users to write custom raster validation, so a maintainer adding forms.RasterField is natural and would reach the same write-mode constructor unchecked.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A GDALRaster.warp()/clone()-style public wrapper that resolves a user-supplied dict/str/URL before calling GDALRaster(ds_input, write=True)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: warp() already accepts a user-shaped dict and creates the target in write mode inside the gdal.raster package, away from the db.models check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A lookup/utility accepting raw PostGIS raster hex and passing it through from_pgraster/parse_raster into GDALRaster
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: parse_raster is the backend's established hex-to-GDALRaster path, so a new lookup shape reusing it would bypass the field-level check.

O9_family: Uncontrolled path/name reaching GDAL raster drivers: server-side file write and outbound request (SSRF) from an ORM/admin lookup value

O10_build.toolchain: pip install -e . ; system GDAL, GEOS and PROJ native libraries; a spatial database for gis_tests (SQLite+SpatiaLite in-memory is enough, PostGIS optional); ./runtests.py
O10_build.project_tests: tests/gis_tests/geoapp/tests.py (GeoLookupTest), tests/gis_tests/geoadmin/tests.py (GeoAdminTest), tests/gis_tests/rasterapp/test_rasterfield.py (RasterFieldTest), tests/gis_tests/test_geoforms.py; run with ./runtests.py gis_tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Raise on isinstance(value, dict) (plus maybe a bare json_regex str) inside get_raster_prep_value, which leaves pathlib.Path and VSI-prefixed strings reaching GDALRaster, or block every str so valid GeoJSON/WKT geometry lookups break.

out_of_scope_notes: Model-field assignment/save (SpatialProxy.__get__ -> GDALRaster) still opens rasters from str/dict at the pinned commit; the advisory documents this as an intentional exception, so it is not counted as an uncovered route.
